kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Will even one of the U.N.'s 17 'sustainable development goals' be met by 2030?
wire.summary: The 17 goals agreed upon by world leaders are incredibly ambitious. Are we even close to achieving any of them? If we don't, is the project a failure?

wire.title: Judge says Trump can't demolish Kennedy Center. And, lawsuits target voter intimidation
wire.summary: A federal judge ruled yesterday that President Trump cannot tear down the Kennedy Center without a 30-day notice. And, recent lawsuits seek to keep armed federal officers away from polling sites.

wire.title: Ms. Rachel has entered her album era, and she is so happy about it
wire.summary: Ms. Rachel has conquered YouTube, Netflix and the toy aisle. Now she's making an album, with real instruments, big feelings and her littlest listeners in mind.

wire.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
wire.summary: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after serving in the role for more than 50 years. His son, Howard, will become Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman

wire.title: South Africa 'feels like a prison' for women amid spate of femicides
wire.summary: South Africa has some of the highest rates of violence against women in the world, and a spate of killings of nine women in the same area in recent weeks has led to renewed outrage.

wire.title: True or false: Trump's name is now on the Kennedy Center. The quiz has the answer
wire.summary: The world made it to another Friday without an AI apocalypse, so here's the quiz! See you next week … maybe.

wire.title: Could trees developed with gene-editing technology protect Florida's citrus industry?
wire.summary: A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.

wire.title: Republican 'cavalry' arrives with a Trump-backed $150 million ad blitz in key races
wire.summary: To counter a difficult political environment, two Trump-aligned super PACs have reserved more than $150 million in ads — primarily in deep red House and Senate races that have now become competitive.

wire.title: A DHS email raises new questions about the Trump administration's election plans
wire.summary: A heavily redacted email from last year, reported first by NPR, reveals that DHS personnel shared a list of jurisdictions that offer election materials in non-English languages. It's unclear why.

wire.title: How Google is drafting AI chatbot laws around the country
wire.summary: As states push to regulate chatbots, tech companies are trying to write safety rules in ways that exempt some of their key products.

wire.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
wire.summary: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

wire.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
wire.summary: The gunman is among the dead in what is the third school shooting in the country since June.

wire.title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
wire.summary: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.

wire.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
wire.summary: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

wire.title: At least 17 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
wire.summary: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

wire.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
wire.summary: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
